title: Prepare a new-unit Plan
responsibility: Checks a creation request’s selected project and runner before returning a context for proposing a new unit.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.preparation
inputs.description: The project session, provider discovery, image generator and event callback.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.request
inputs.description: A creation request with create intent, plan mode, explicit project identity and chosen provider, model and effort.

inputs.name: prepareProjectRun.controller
inputs.description: The cancellation controller whose signal will govern the run.

outputs.name: prepareProjectRun
outputs.description: A promise for a fresh run identity, selected mutable project and revision, planning access, exact chosen runner and cancellation signal. No entity or design is created by this helper.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a non-Plan creation request, invalid or unselected project, non-writable project, unavailable provider/model/effort or underlying preparation failure.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects when the controller is already aborted after project and provider preparation, before returning the context.
